messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
likelihood that privacy will become a thing of the past is low, because encryption, regulation, and social norms will keep some information hidden, even as data collection becomes intrusive likelihood
likelihood that we can copy human consciousness to a computer by the early 2030s is extremely low, because the science of subjective experience, neural mapping, and full-body emulation is far from mature likelihood
likelihood that wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet is moderate to high over decades, though mountains, oceans, caves, and remote regions will remain hard to cover everywhere likelihood
likelihood that all forms of transport will eventually become electric is high for road and rail, but low for heavy aviation and shipping unless energy and materials limits are overcome likelihood
likelihood that the effects of climate change will be irreversible is high for many locked-in changes, such as sea level rise and ecosystem shifts, even if some harms can still be reduced likelihood
likelihood that physical money will not exist anymore is moderate at best, because digital systems may dominate, but governments and users may keep cash for resilience, privacy, and offline life likelihood
likelihood that scientists will unlock genetic secrets that allow us to live for centuries or forever is very low in the near term, though research may slow aging enough to be transformative likelihood
